card.title: 85 PIONEER COMPANY
card.text: The first order you play each turn costs 1 less.
card.flavorText: The 85th Pioneer Company served under the Royal Pioneer Corps of the British Army during WWII. On D-Day in 1944 the 85th Company served with the 6th Beach Group assisting the units landing on Sword Beach. Pioneer units performed a variety of tasks during WWII, and in all theaters of war, including stretcher-bearing, handling all types of stores, laying prefabricated track on beaches or airfields, and working various logistical operations.
